sloka: प्रहृष्टम् इह ते वक्त्रम् गत असोः अपि मानद ।अस्त अर्क सम वर्णम् च दृश्यते जीवतो यथा ॥४-२५-४२॥
transliteration: prahṛṣṭam iha te vaktram gata asoḥ api mānada ।asta arka sama varṇam ca dṛśyate jīvato yathā ॥4-25-42॥

translations.english: 'O monkey a single arrow from Rama who appeared in the forest in the form of death dragged you away from us and turned us all into widows.
